backups.title: Database backups

state.fresh: Newest backup is {{hours}} hours old (limit {{limit}} hours).
state.stale: Newest backup is {{hours}} hours old — older than the {{limit}} hour limit. The backup job is not producing dumps.
state.empty: No backups found in the bucket yet.
state.error: Could not read the backup bucket.
state.misconfigured: Backups are turned on but set up incorrectly, so none are being taken.
state.setupMissing: Backups are turned on but the off-site bucket is not configured yet.
state.unknown: No freshness check has run yet. The worker records one every 6 hours.

reason.futureTimestamp: The newest backup is dated in the future, so its age cannot be trusted. The clock on the machine that made it is probably wrong.

backups.docsHint: If backups are missing or out of date, ask whoever deploys this app to set them up — you cannot enable them from here.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.description: Background tasks that failed recently, such as search indexing, model downloads, email delivery and mirror pushes.
jobs.noneFailedDescription: No background task has failed recently. This page refreshes automatically while open.

overview.title: Admin overview
overview.description: Manage accounts, background jobs, backups and instance-wide security settings.

setupBanner.title: No administrators configured
setupBanner.message: Set <0>ADMIN_EMAIL</0> in your environment and restart the server to enable admin features. See your deployment's production hardening docs for details.
setupBanner.errorMessage: The app could not check whether administrators are configured. Review the server logs before publishing.
setupBanner.firstAccountAdmin: <0>ADMIN_EMAIL</0> is not set, so the first account that signed up became the administrator. Set <0>ADMIN_EMAIL</0> to choose the administrator explicitly.

settings.title: Admin Settings
settings.force2faInternalDescription: Required by default. Admin users must set up two-factor authentication before they can use internal tools; a newly created admin account has 24 hours to enroll before it loses access.
settings.force2faPublicDescription: When enabled, signed-in non-admin users must set up two-factor authentication before they can use the application.
settings.force2faAdminWarning: You must enable 2FA for your own account before you can require it for others. Go to Security settings to set it up.
settings.force2faInternalEnabled: Two-factor authentication is now required for administrators
settings.force2faInternalDisabled: Two-factor authentication is no longer required for administrators
settings.force2faPublicEnabled: Two-factor authentication is now required for public users
settings.force2faPublicDisabled: Two-factor authentication is no longer required for public users
settings.updateFailed: Couldn't update that setting. Try again.

model.title: Built-in embedding model
model.description: Enable one optional local model, downloaded to the model volume. Each knowledge base can use this built-in or a user provider.
model.notExecutable: Search cannot use this model until the worker has downloaded and verified it with its runtime.
model.executable: Verified: every user can attach the built-in model to knowledge bases they manage.
model.disableKeepsWeights: Disable keeps the downloaded weights, so enabling again needs no download. Knowledge bases that use the model keep keyword search meanwhile.
model.removeDescription: The worker deletes {{fileName}} from the model volume. Enabling the model again downloads it again. Knowledge bases that use it keep keyword search until then.
model.removalPending: Removal requested: the worker deletes the downloaded weights shortly.
model.removeFailed: Couldn't remove the model weights. Try again.
model.updateFailed: Couldn't change the model state. Try again.

errors.MODEL_HOST_REJECTED: The download was redirected to a host that is not allowed.
errors.MODEL_PRIVATE_NETWORK: The download host resolved to a private network address.
errors.MODEL_REDIRECT_LIMIT: The download was redirected too many times.
errors.MODEL_HTTP_STATUS: The download server returned an error.
errors.MODEL_SIZE_MISMATCH: The downloaded file has the wrong size.
errors.MODEL_CHECKSUM_MISMATCH: The downloaded file failed checksum verification and was deleted.
errors.MODEL_DOWNLOAD_FAILED: The download could not be completed.
errors.MODEL_DISK_QUOTA: Not enough free disk space on the model volume.
errors.MODEL_RUNTIME_UNSUPPORTED: The verified model could not be loaded by this worker's runtime (unsupported platform).
errors.MODEL_VOLUME_BUSY: Another worker is using the model volume.

runtime.title: Runtime settings
runtime.description: Select a model and a measured context tier. Settings take effect after a successful load probe; attached knowledge bases rebuild sequentially.
runtime.current: Context {{contextTokens}} tokens · K cache {{k}} · V cache {{v}} · batch {{batch}} · flash attention on
runtime.budgetUnknown: No worker has reported its memory budget yet. Runtime settings cannot be changed until one does.
runtime.peakUnknown: Measured peak: not observed yet under these settings.
runtime.optionsCaption: Estimated peak memory per context length for the selected cache types

level.block: Blocked: at or above 90% of the memory budget

runtime.acknowledge: I understand this may use more than 70% of the worker's memory.
runtime.reindexNotice: New settings are load-tested first (the model is loaded and one full-context input is embedded); they take effect only if that succeeds. Then every knowledge base that uses the built-in model is re-embedded, one at a time. Until each is rebuilt, its search uses the index built with the previous settings.
runtime.applyFailed: Couldn't change the runtime settings. Try again.
runtime.applyConfirmDescription: The built-in model reloads with the new settings, then every knowledge base that uses it rebuilds its semantic index, one at a time. Keyword search keeps working meanwhile.
runtime.reembedProgress: Re-embedding after the last settings change: {{done}} / {{total}}

pending.queued: Requested: context {{contextTokens}} tokens · K cache {{k}} · V cache {{v}}. Waiting for the worker to load-test it; the current settings stay active.
pending.probing: Load-testing context {{contextTokens}} tokens · K cache {{k}} · V cache {{v}} next to the current settings.
pending.probingExclusive: Load-testing context {{contextTokens}} tokens · K cache {{k}} · V cache {{v}}. The current settings are paused to make room, so search is keyword-only for a moment.

probeError.MODEL_CONFIG_PROBE_FAILED: Context {{contextTokens}} tokens · K cache {{k}} · V cache {{v}} could not be loaded or failed a full-context embedding. The previous settings stay active.
probeError.MODEL_CONFIG_PROBE_TIMEOUT: Context {{contextTokens}} tokens · K cache {{k}} · V cache {{v}} did not finish its load test in time. The previous settings stay active.
probeError.MODEL_CONFIG_PROBE_INTERRUPTED: The worker stopped while load-testing context {{contextTokens}} tokens · K cache {{k}} · V cache {{v}}. The previous settings stay active; check the worker's memory before trying again.

model.enableLabel: Enable and download the built-in embedding model
model.disableConfirmDescription: Every knowledge base that uses the built-in model falls back to keyword search until you enable it again. The downloaded model file is kept, so enabling needs no download; use Remove to delete it.
model.affected_one: {{count}} knowledge base uses the built-in model now.
model.affected_other: {{count}} knowledge bases use the built-in model now.
model.affectedNone: No knowledge base uses the built-in model now.
model.affectedUnknown: Couldn't count the knowledge bases that use the built-in model.

indexCeiling.title: Index chunk ceilings
indexCeiling.description: The largest chunk limit a knowledge base owner may set, per quantization. Knowledge bases above a lowered ceiling are held to it on their next build.
indexCeiling.loadFailed: Couldn't load the index chunk ceilings.
indexCeiling.boundExceeded: Enter a whole number from 1 to {{bound, number}}.
indexCeiling.failed: Couldn't save the ceiling. Try again.

force2faConfirm.internalEnableDescription: Admins who haven't set up two-factor authentication must do so before they can keep using admin tools.
force2faConfirm.internalDisableDescription: Admin accounts can then be used with a password alone. Admins who already set up two-factor authentication keep it.
force2faConfirm.publicEnableDescription: Signed-in users who haven't set up two-factor authentication must do so before they can keep using the app.
force2faConfirm.publicDisableDescription: Users can then sign in with a password alone. Users who already set up two-factor authentication keep it.

twoFactorNudge.title: Two-factor authentication is not set up
twoFactorNudge.message: Your admin account signs in with a password alone. Add an authenticator app as a second factor so a stolen password can't unlock this dashboard.
twoFactorNudge.requiredTitle: Two-factor authentication is required for your admin account
twoFactorNudge.requiredMessage: Add an authenticator app as a second factor {{deadline}}. After that, this dashboard stays locked until you finish enrolling.
twoFactorNudge.blockedTitle: Admin access is locked until you set up two-factor authentication
twoFactorNudge.blockedMessage: Your enrollment window has closed, so admin actions are being refused. Set up an authenticator app now to get this dashboard back.
twoFactorNudge.configurable: An admin who has already enrolled can change this policy under Settings in the admin dashboard.

users.title: Users
users.description: Invite new members, change roles, archive, or permanently delete accounts.
users.roleUpdateFailed: Couldn't update that role. Try again.
users.archiveFailed: Couldn't archive that user. Try again.
users.restoreFailed: Couldn't restore that user. Try again.
users.deleteFailed: Couldn't delete that user. Try again.
users.inviteDescription: Creates the account and emails a one-time link where the new user sets their own password, which also confirms their email. No password is sent. If email isn't configured, you get the link to share instead.
users.revealEmailedDescription: {{email}} has been emailed a one-time link to set their password. It expires in 72 hours.
users.revealNotEmailedDescription: The account for {{email}} was created, but the email could not be sent. Share this one-time link with them through another channel. It expires in 72 hours.
users.deleteDescription: This permanently removes the account and its sessions. This cannot be undone. To preserve a user's authored content, archive them instead.
users.typeEmailToConfirm: Type the user's email to confirm

confirm.promoteDescription: Admins manage every user, invitation, security policy and the built-in embedding model. Knowledge base access doesn't change: admins only see knowledge bases shared with them.
confirm.demoteDescription: They lose the admin area right away. Their knowledge bases and shares don't change.
confirm.archiveDescription: They're signed out and can't sign in until you restore the account. Every access token and connected app they have is revoked for good; restoring doesn't bring them back. Their knowledge bases and documents are kept.

users.setPasswordLinkHint: Anyone with this link can set the password for this account, and it works only once. Send it only to the invited person.
